about: 3,000 years in 40 seconds: structure short 7 (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-30-structure-shorts-design.md). A terminal log, the year ticking over, one entry per page; Blender: a slow push along a corridor of dates (blender/searchlight.py). Queued overnight 2026-10-01. Draft 2: Astra's revision adopted as is, round 1 (docs/research/2026-10-01-codex-structure-timeline.md). Copy only; the Blender scene is a new style and gets a smoke test first.
hexagramNote: the end card and its track come from 22, as in the two lessons, so the terminal pieces end alike
style: The header reads 'SIX LINES // READY FOR INQUIRY' throughout. Each query clears the screen like a filmbook page. The query is typed after '>' (dim green); the answer types out below it (bright green, 48 px); the part of the readout the answer is about is drawn beside it, alone. Chapter pages: a single word, centred, held 2 s. Own names only, never MU/TH/UR or INTERFACE 2037.

music.why: calm, 92 bpm, A# minor, from 8 s as on 4, 22, 26 and 41; no other structure short uses it

caption: A Chinese book about change, from origin stories to a diagram sent to Leibniz and a novel plotted with its help. A few dates in the I Ching’s history; sixlines.day.
